units.source_text: 托喀对谈论河童的生活和艺术十分感兴趣。

en.t: Toka was very interested in talking about the life and art of the kappa.

units.source_text: 在他眼里，河童的正常生活就是世界上最荒唐的事儿。

en.t: In his eyes, the ordinary life of the kappa was the most absurd thing in the world.

units.source_text: 父母儿女、夫妇、兄弟姐妹共同生活，把互相折磨当成生活唯一乐趣。

en.t: Parents and children, husbands and wives, brothers and sisters lived together, taking the tormenting of one another as life's only pleasure.

units.source_text: 最荒唐的就是他们的家族制度。

en.t: The most absurd thing of all was their family system.

units.source_text: 有一回，托喀指了指窗外，啐道：“你看他们多么愚蠢可笑！”

en.t: One time, Toka pointed out the window and spat, "Look how stupid and ridiculous they are!"

units.source_text: 外面的马路上，一只年轻的河童脖子上挂着七八只雌雄河童——中间有两个像是他的父母，累得气喘吁吁。

en.t: Out on the road, seven or eight male and female kappa were hanging from the neck of one young kappa; two of them seemed to be his parents, and they were panting with exhaustion.

units.source_text: 我很佩服这个年轻河童大无私的牺牲精神，反而大加赞扬。

en.t: I greatly admired the selfless spirit of sacrifice shown by this young kappa, and instead praised him highly.
